Name: Welwick's Animal Feed
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
Got modded animals? Does it make your brain itch that some of them shouldn't be eating hay? Yeah me too.

Introducing a replacement for hay...Welwick's Animal Feed! It mysteriously meets the needs of every animal out there. You could probably even eat it! Maybe.

This mod will overwrite vanilla hay so it's what the animals get from the hoppers and what you can buy at Marnie's. 

Enjoy!
